messages:
ivy (AE): Lumenica sent an RFI — wants a 2-week POC: private deployment in their VPC, BYOH HSM via PKCS#11, 7yr audit retention, embeddings at ~80 QPS and gen at ~30 QPS. Also asked for capability matrix, short test plan, and a ballpark POC quote. Need a draft by EOD tomorrow.
omar (Sales Eng): Got it. Quick checks: 1) region? 2) embedding seq and gen avg tokens? 3) will they accept Redwood-managed HSM as a fallback?
ivy (AE): Region: us-east-2. Embeddings seq ~512, gen avg 256. They prefer BYOH but will consider managed HSM if we document differences.
greta (Solutions): I'll assemble the capability matrix mapping their asks to our features: private control plane, VPC peering methods (NAT vs PrivateLink), BYOH PKCS#11 + Redwood-managed HSM, audit logging (S3/GCS retention options), and performance caveats. I'll include attachments: BYOH playbook, sample deployment YAML, and a condensed test plan.
ken (SRE): Notes for RFI: BYOH PKCS#11 is supported but network latency to customer HSM can add ~5-15ms per crypto op. For target throughput, recommend dedicated pool: 4 x A10x (or equiv) with workload-aware batching. Peering provisioning typically 24-48h. Audit retention 7yrs is fine but storage/TCO needs separate line item.
omar (Sales Eng): Draft pricing (placeholder): 4 GPUs reserved 2 weeks = $16,800; peering & ops onboarding = $2,250; SE support (2 days) = $3,000; audit storage delta ~$140/mo. I'll convert to formal quote when matrix finalized.
greta (Solutions): Example config snippet I'll add to attachments:
```
# sample private deployment + hsm binding
deployment:
  mode: private
  region: us-east-2
  vpc_peering: true
  hsm:
    interface: "pkcs11"
    endpoint: "tcp://10.2.3.8:7777"
  audit:
    retention_days: 2555  # ~7 years
```
sec-bot: playbook-uploaded: "byoh-hsm-playbook-v1.pdf" available at https://redwood.internal/playbooks/byoh-hsm-playbook-v1
ken (SRE): Add test plan items: validate HSM ops/sec under load (target 200 ops/sec headroom), measure p95 gen latency at 256 tokens, validate embeddings QPS at 80 under load, and verify audit log delivery and retention lifecycle. Also include fallback: if BYOH unavailable, use Redwood-managed HSM with customer-supplied key material and document SLA differences.
ivy (AE): Good. Can we get the capability matrix and one-page procurement summary before lunch tomorrow? I want to pre-send to their procurement lead.
greta (Solutions): I'll upload matrix draft to /sales/lumenica/rfi-draft-v1 in ~3 hours and flag Omar for quote embedding.
omar (Sales Eng): Will sync pricing to match the final model/seqs. Also adding a short risk section: BYOH network latency, required infra lead time for peering, and HSM throughput validation.
ivy (AE): Thanks team 64f
